messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy start: staged rollout v3.4.2 -> 5% (regions: global). Initiator: maria. Command: `/deploy start --version v3.4.2 --percent 5`

maria: Kicking off canary now. preflight checks green from infra. Will watch telemetry.

sam: LGTM from QA. smoke passed. watching p50/p99 latency + 5xx rate.

jon: @maria heads-up — watch KV cache pressure and tokenization errors. Suggest a 15m pause before any bump to 20%.

pq-monitor: ALERT: eu-west 502-rate +0.8% (baseline +0.3%). Threshold is 0.5%. Sampled traces indicate grpc timeouts to model-host-12.

maria: I see the same on dashboards (eu-west). p99 latency up ~120ms over baseline for that region. Proposing HOLD and pin the release to contain blast radius.

sam: Vote: HOLD. Put a pin and open rollback runbook so we can act quickly.

ops-sre: +1 HOLD. Stated rollback criteria: sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 3m OR p99 latency > 500ms for 3m -> trigger rollback. Rollback steps (high level):
1) `/deploy rollback --version v3.4.1 --percent 100`
2) verify 5xx drop and p99 recovery
3) notify customers + update postmortem tracker

jon: Adding detail: I see some short 429 bursts tied to batching heuristic change. If rollback is needed we can instead revert batching config first (less disruptive) — I can prep the config revert.

maria: Ok — two parallel options: config revert (jon) vs full rollback (ops-sre). For now we will NOT bump further. Pinning release and triaging traces.

ops-sre: Command recorded: `/release pin v3.4.2 --scope all --reason "hold for eu-west 5xx" --expires 1753223600`

deploy-bot: Pin applied by ops-sre. Rolling pause engaged; percent bumps disabled until manual resume.

maria: @jon please take ownership of the trace triage and config revert PR. @sam please prepare the short customer-facing blurb for support in case rollback happens.

sam: On it. Drafting note for #support and will ping oncall.

ops-sre: Rollback checklist link: https://wiki.redwood/release/rollback-v3.4.2 — follow runbook and escalate if any step fails.

maria: Re-eval in 10m or earlier if the alert clears/worsens. Thanks all. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Thread state: PAUSED (pinned). Use `/deploy resume --version v3.4.2` to continue after approval.
